title: Chanel sells majority Capsum stake to Motion Equity Partners
summary: Innovation and manufacturing partner Capsum is now under Motion Equity Partners, with luxury brand and long term partner Chanel remaining a minority shareholder in the company

extraction.key_fact: 샤넬이 혁신·제조 파트너 캡섬의 지분 과반을 모션 에쿼티 파트너스에 매각했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Chanel sells majority Capsum stake to Motion Equity Partners
